episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: To work beside her idol, Chan, Da-reum joins startup APPELLO but instead faces a prickly, suspicious CEO.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Da-reum wants to be the best employee so he can travel with his idol, Chan, but his enthusiasm only makes the CEO even more suspicious.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: The fashion show is on the verge of cancellation, and to make matters worse, Ha-gi is convinced that Da-reum is a spy.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Da-reum finds herself caught in a love triangle.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Ha-gi and Da-reum grow closer on a secret business trip.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: A major shift changes everything after the season's first snow.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Ha-gi prepares to confess his true feelings - only to be blindsided at the crucial moment.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: A harsh boycott throws the company into chaos.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Ha-gi and Da-reum's secret workplace romance is put to the test.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Jeong-yeon's return sparks jealousy, while a shocking discovery pushes Da-reum to the edge.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: A mole shatters the company, driving a betrayed Ha-gi to vanish.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Da-reum receives a life-changing offer while D.N.X reunites onstage.
